items.title: We don’t need AI regulation — leave safety to us, Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says
items.summary: AI isn't some new form of "alien mind," according to Jensen Huang. It's just hardware and software, so safety can be engineered by each AI product maker.
items.author: Julie Bort

items.title: The AI data center boom is colliding with cities scarred by big industry
items.summary: National outcry against data center construction has spread to Philadelphia, where officials suggested possible construction in a neighborhood already impacted by a now-defunct oil refinery.
items.author: Amanda Silberling

items.title: Meta now lets AI agents handle the boring parts of WhatsApp Business setup
items.summary: A new WhatsApp Business MCP server lets developers use AI coding agents like Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT to handle setup, messaging templates, testing, and troubleshooting.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
items.summary: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.
items.author: Lauren Forristal

items.title: US data centers could consume more natural gas than Germany and Japan combined by 2035
items.summary: The AI frenzy could push U.S. data centers to become one of the largest consumers of natural gas in the world.
items.author: Tim De Chant

items.title: AI agents now have a place to snitch
items.summary: The AI Contact Hotline is designed to be a discreet place where agents that have witnessed misbehavior can tip off authorities.
items.author: Aditya Mehta

items.title: Meta expands subscription push with new AI-focused plans
items.summary: Meta One bundles expanded access to the company’s AI tools with premium features across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.
items.author: Sarah Perez

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google have been in talks on AI safety for weeks
items.summary: OpenAI confirms weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, as Trump's team dismisses safety concerns and pushes to keep pace with China.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: AEO startup Profound hits unicorn valuation, raises $180M Series D 7 months after last round
items.summary: Profound has raised a $180 million Series D at a $1.8 billion valuation, less than seven months after it raised a $96 million Series C.
items.author: Dominic-Madori Davis

items.title: Former TikTok execs built an app that uses AI to teach you how to pose for a photo
items.summary: Essentially a camera app, Superpose analyzes selfies or photos and generates four potential poses using AI.
items.author: Ivan Mehta

items.title: Early Anthropic hire, former METR COO have found a way to rein in rogue AI agents
items.summary: Their startup, Artificial Intelligence Underwriting Company (AIUC) has raised $40 million in a Series A round led by Ribbit Capital, with participation from First Harmonic.

items.title: Salesforce and Nvidia’s new reasoning model is everything the AI labs should fear
items.summary: Salesforce Koa is built on Nvidia's open-weight Nemotron model and is trained to do sales, marketing, and customer-support tasks.
